verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ هٰذَا كِتَابُكَ الْمُنْزَلُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَلٰى رَسُوْلِكَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ،
verses.roman: Allahumma inni ashhadu anna hadha kitabukal munzalu min 'indika 'ala rasulika Muhammadibni 'Abdillahi sallallahu 'alayhi wa alihi,
verses.english: O Allah! Indeed I bear witness that this is Your Book, revealed from You upon Your Messenger Muhammad son of Abdullah, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his Progeny,

verses.arabic: وَكَلَامُكَ النَّاطِقُ عَلٰى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّكَ، جَعَلْتَهٗ هَادِيًا مِنْكَ اِلٰى خَلْقِكَ، وَحَبْلًا مُتَّصِلًا فِيْمَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ۔
verses.roman: wa kalamukan natiqu 'ala lisani nabiyyika, ja'altahu hadiyan minka ila khalqika, wa hablan muttasilan fima baynaka wa bayna 'ibadika.
verses.english: and Your speaking Word upon the tongue of Your Prophet, which You have made a guide from You to Your creation, and a continuous rope connecting You and Your servants.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ نَشَرْتُ عَهْدَكَ وَكِتَابَكَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاجْعَلْ نَظَرِيْ فِيْهِ عِبَادَةً، وَقِرَآءَتِيْ فِيْهِ فِكْرًا، وَفِكْرِيْ فِيْهِ اعْتِبَارًا،
verses.roman: Allahumma inni nashartu 'ahdaka wa kitabaka, Allahumma faj'al nazari fihi 'ibadatan, wa qira'ati fihi fikran, wa fikri fihil 'itibaran,
verses.english: O Allah! I have opened Your covenant and Your Book. O Allah, make my looking into it an act of worship, my recitation of it deep reflection, and my reflection upon it a source of lesson,

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِمَّنِ اتَّعَظَ بِبَيَانِ مَوَاعِظِكَ فِيْهِ، وَاجْتَنَبَ مَعَاصِيَكَ، وَلَا تَطْبَعْ عِنْدَ قِرَآءَتِيْ عَلٰى سَمْعِيْ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ عَلٰى بَصَرِيْ غِشَاوَةً،
verses.roman: waj'alni mimmanit ta'aza bi-bayani mawa'izika fihi, wajtanaba ma'asiyaka, wa la tatba' 'inda qira'ati 'ala sam'i, wa la taj'al 'ala basari ghishawatan,
verses.english: and make me among those who take heed from the clarity of Your admonitions in it and shun disobedience to You. Do not seal my hearing during my recitation, nor place a veil over my sight,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ قِرَآءَتِيْ قِرَآءَةً لَا تَدَبُّرَ فِيْهَا، بَلِ اجْعَلْنِيْ اَتَدَبَّرُ اٰيَاتِهٖ وَاَحْكَامَهٗ، اٰخِذًا بِشَرَايِعِ دِيْنِكَ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ نَظَرِيْ فِيْهِ غَفْلَةً، وَلَا قِرَآءَتِيْ هَذْرًا، اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الرَّؤُوْفُ الرَّحِيْمُ۔
verses.roman: wa la taj'al qira'ati qira'atan la tadabbura fiha, balij'alni atadabbaru ayatihi wa ahkamahu, akhidhan bi-sharayi'i dinika, wa la taj'al nazari fihi ghaflatan, wa la qira'ati hadhran, innaka antar-Ra'ufur-Rahim.
verses.english: and do not make my recitation a recitation devoid of contemplation; rather make me ponder over its verses and its laws, adhering to the ordinances of Your religion. Do not let my looking into it be heedlessness nor my recitation be hasty babble. Verily, You are the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ قَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا قَضَيْتَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ الَّذِيْ اَنْزَلْتَهٗ عَلٰى نَبِيِّكَ الصَّادِقِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ رَبَّنَا۔
verses.roman: Allahumma inni qad qara'tu ma qadayta min kitabikal ladhi anzaltahu 'ala nabiyyikas sadiqi sallallahu 'alayhi wa alihi, falakal hamdu Rabbana.
verses.english: O Allah! Indeed I have recited what You decreed for me from Your Book which You revealed to Your truthful Prophet, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his Progeny. So to You belongs all praise, O our Lord.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِمَّنْ يُحِلُّ حَلَالَهٗ، وَيُحَرِّمُ حَرَامَهٗ، وَيُؤْمِنُ بِمُحْكَمِهٖ وَمُتَشَابِهِهٖ،
verses.roman: Allahummaj'alni mimman yuhillu halalahu, wa yuharrimu haramahu, wa yu'minu bi-muhkamihi wa mutashabihihi,
verses.english: O Allah! Make me among those who regard as lawful what it permits, who regard as forbidden what it prohibits, and who believe in its decisive verses and its allegorical verses,

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُ لِيْ اُنْسًا فِيْ قَبْرِيْ، وَاُنْسًا فِيْ حَشْرِيْ، وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِمَّنْ تُرَقِّيْهِ بِكُلِّ اٰيَةٍ قَرَأَهَا دَرَجَةً فِيْ اَعْلٰى عِلِّيِّيْنَ، اٰمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ۔
verses.roman: waj'alhu li unsan fi qabri, wa unsan fi hashri, waj'alni mimman turaqqihi bi-kulli ayatin qara'aha darajatan fi a'la 'illiyyin, amina Rabbal 'alamin.
verses.english: and make it a comforting companion for me in my grave and a companion for me at my resurrection, and make me among those whom You elevate by a rank in the highest heavens ('Illiyyin) for every verse they recited. Ameen, O Lord of the worlds.

duas.title: Salaamti e Imam e Zamana (ajtf)
duas.subtitle: Dua for the safety of Imam al-Mahdi (a.t.f.s.)

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ كُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْحُجَّةِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى اٰبَائِهٖ فِيْ هٰذِهِ السَّاعَةِ وَفِيْ كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ
verses.roman: Allahumma kun li-waliyyikal Hujjatibnil Hasan, salawatuka 'alayhi wa 'ala aba'ihi, fi hadhihis sa'ati wa fi kulli sa'atin,
verses.english: O Allah! Be for Your representative, al-Hujjah son of al-Hasan — Your blessings be upon him and upon his forefathers — in this hour and in every hour,

verses.arabic: وَلِيًّا وَحَافِظًا وَقَائِدًا وَنَاصِرًا وَدَلِيْلًا وَعَيْنًا حَتّٰى تُسْكِنَهٗ اَرْضَكَ طَوْعًا وَتُمَتِّعَهٗ فِيْهَا طَوِيْلًا۔
verses.roman: waliyyan wa hafizan wa qa'idan wa nasiran wa dalilan wa 'aynan, hatta tuskinahu ardaka taw'an wa tumatti'ahu fiha tawila.
verses.english: a guardian, a protector, a leader, a helper, a guide, and a watchful eye, until You let him dwell upon Your earth willingly and let him enjoy it for a long time.

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ عَظُمَ الْبَلَاءُ وَبَرِحَ الْخَفَاءُ وَانْكَشَفَ الْغِطَاءُ وَانْقَطَعَ الرَّجَاءُ وَضَاقَتِ الْاَرْضُ وَمُنِعَتِ السَّمَاءُ
verses.roman: Ilahi 'azumal bala'u wa barihal khafa'u wankashafal ghita'u wanqata'ar raja'u wa daqatil ardu wa muni'atis sama'u,
verses.english: O my God! Terrible is the calamity, its hidden nature has become manifest, the veil has been lifted, hope has been cut off, the earth has become straitened, and the sky withholds its blessings.

verses.arabic: وَاَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْمُشْتَكٰى وَعَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِي الشِّدَّةِ وَالرَّخَاءِ۔
verses.roman: wa antal musta'anu wa ilaykal mushtaka wa 'alaykal mu'awwalu fish-shiddati war-rakha'i.
verses.english: And You alone are the One sought for help; to You is our complaint, and upon You is our reliance in hardship and in ease.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اُوْلِي الْاَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَاعَتَهُمْ وَعَرَّفْتَنَا بِذٰلِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ، فَفَرِّجْ عَنَّا بِحَقِّهِمْ فَرَجًا عَاجِلًا قَرِيْبًا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ اَوْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُ۔
verses.roman: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammadin ulil amril ladhina faradta 'alayna ta'atahum wa 'arraftana bi-dhalika manzilatahum, fa-farrij 'anna bi-haqqihim farajan 'ajilan qariban ka-lamhil basari aw huwa aqrab.
verses.english: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, those vested with authority whose obedience You have made obligatory upon us and thereby made known to us their station. So grant us relief by their right — an immediate, near relief, like the twinkling of an eye or even closer.

verses.arabic: يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا عَلِيُّ يَا عَلِيُّ يَا مُحَمَّدُ اِكْفِيَانِيْ فَاِنَّكُمَا كَافِيَانِ وَانْصُرَانِيْ فَاِنَّكُمَا نَاصِرَانِ۔ يَا مَوْلَانَا يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ، اَلْغَوْثَ اَلْغَوْثَ اَلْغَوْثَ، اَدْرِكْنِيْ اَدْرِكْنِيْ اَدْرِكْنِيْ، اَلسَّاعَةَ اَلسَّاعَةَ اَلسَّاعَةَ، اَلْعَجَلَ اَلْعَجَلَ اَلْعَجَلَ، يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ۔
verses.roman: Ya Muhammadu Ya 'Aliyyu, Ya 'Aliyyu Ya Muhammadu, ikfiyani fa-innakuma kafiyani, wansurani fa-innakuma nasirani. Ya Mawlana Ya Sahibaz-Zaman! Al-ghawth, al-ghawth, al-ghawth! Adrikni, adrikni, adrikni! As-sa'ah, as-sa'ah, as-sa'ah! Al-'ajal, al-'ajal, al-'ajal! Ya Arhamar-Rahimin bi-haqqi Muhammadin wa alihit-tahirin.
verses.english: O Muhammad, O Ali; O Ali, O Muhammad! Suffice me, for you both are sufficient; aid me, for you both are helpers. O our Master, O Master of the Time! Help, help, help! Reach me, reach me, reach me! This very hour, this very hour, this very hour! Make haste, make haste, make haste! O Most Merciful of the merciful, by the right of Muhammad and his pure Progeny.

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
verses.roman: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum; la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm; lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard; man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih; ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum; wa la yuhituna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bi-ma sha'; wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard; wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma wa huwal-'aliyyul-'azim.
verses.english: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

verses.arabic: لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِالطَّاغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ لَا انفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.roman: La ikraha fid-din; qad tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayy; faman yakfur bit-taghuti wa yu'min billahi faqadistamsaka bil-'urwatil-wuthqa lanfisama laha; wallahu sami'un 'alim.
verses.english: There shall be no compulsion in religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَوْلِيَاؤُهُمُ الطَّاغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ النُّورِ إِلَى الظُّلُمَاتِ ۗ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
verses.roman: Allahu waliyyul-ladhina amanu yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumati ilan-nur; walladhina kafaru awliya'uhumut-taghutu yukhrijunahum minan-nuri ilaz-zulumat; ula'ika ashabun-nar, hum fiha khalidun.
verses.english: Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light. And those who disbelieve — their allies are Taghut. They take them out of the light into darknesses. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein.

duas.title: Dua e Khatme Quraan
duas.subtitle: Supplication upon Completing the Holy Quran

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّنَا يَا رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ،
verses.roman: Allahumma Rabbana ya Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Alim, wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim,
verses.english: O Allah, our Lord! Accept from us, for indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And turn toward us in mercy, for indeed You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَاهْدِنَا اِلَى الْحَقِّ وَاِلٰى طَرِيْقٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ بِبَرَكَةِ خَتْمِ الْقُرْاٰنِ الْعَظِيْمِ، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا يَا كَرِيْمُ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَجُوْدِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا اَكْرَمَ الْاَكْرَمِيْنَ وَيَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔
verses.roman: wahdina ilal-haqqi wa ila tariqin mustaqimin bi-barakati khatmil-Qur'anil-'azim, wa'fu 'anna ya Karim, waghfir lana dhunubana bi-fadlika wa judika wa karamika ya Akramal-Akramin wa ya Arhamar-Rahimin.
verses.english: Guide us to the truth and to a straight path by the blessing of completing the Magnificent Quran. Pardon us, O Most Generous, and forgive our sins by Your grace, generosity, and nobility, O Most Generous of the generous and Most Merciful of the merciful.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْ وَاَوْصِلْ ثَوَابَ مَا قَرَأْنَاهُ بَعْدَ الْقَبُوْلِ مِنَّا اِلٰى رَوْضَةِ نَبِيِّنَا وَشَفِيْعِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ وَسَلَّمَ، وَاِلٰى رِيَاضِ جَمِيْعِ الْاَنْبِيَاءِ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَاٰلِهِمُ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ۔
verses.roman: Allahumma balligh wa awsil thawaba ma qara'nahu ba'dal-qabuli minna ila rawdati nabiyyina wa shafi'ina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa alihi wa sallam, wa ila riyadi jami'il-anbiya'i wal-mursalin wa alihimut-tahirin wal-mu'minina wal-mu'minati ajma'in.
verses.english: O Allah! Convey and deliver the reward of what we have recited, after accepting it from us, to the resting place of our Prophet and intercessor Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him and his Progeny), and to all the Prophets and Messengers, their pure Progeny, and all believing men and women.
